mapper.select: select lodging.*, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rv_rating), 1) FROM review join room on rm_num = rv_number WHERE rv_table_name = 'room' AND rm_ld_num = lodging.LD_NUM ) AS avg_rating, MIN(rm_price) as min_price, (select TH_UPLOAD from thumbnail where TH_TABLE="lodging" and th_key =lodging.ld_num limit 1) as main_thumbnail, (select th_name from thumbnail where TH_TABLE="lodging" and th_key =ld_num limit 1) as th_name from lodging join room on rm_ld_num = ld_num where LD_RG_NUM = #{rg_num} group by ld_num order by avg_rating desc limit 7;

select lodging.*, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rv_rating), 1) FROM review join room on rm_num = rv_number WHERE rv_table_name = 'room' AND rm_ld_num = lodging.LD_NUM ) AS avg_rating, MIN(rm_price) as min_price, (select TH_UPLOAD from thumbnail where TH_TABLE="lodging" and th_key =lodging.ld_num limit 1) as main_thumbnail, (select th_name from thumbnail where TH_TABLE="lodging" and th_key =ld_num limit 1) as th_name from lodging join room on rm_ld_num = ld_num where LD_RG_NUM = #{rg_num} group by ld_num order by min_price limit 7;

select lodging.*, ( select round(avg(rv_rating), 1) from review join room on rm_num = rv_number where rv_table_name = 'room' and rm_ld_num = lodging.ld_num ) as avg_rating, min(rm_price) as min_price, count(lo_reservation.lr_num) as reservation_count, (select TH_UPLOAD from thumbnail where TH_TABLE="lodging" and th_key =lodging.ld_num limit 1) as main_thumbnail, (select th_name from thumbnail where TH_TABLE="lodging" and th_key =ld_num limit 1) as th_name from lodging join room on rm_ld_num = ld_num join lo_reservation on rm_num = lr_rm_num where ld_rg_num = #{rg_num} group by lodging.ld_num order by reservation_count desc;
select ld_meal_price from lodging where ld_num = #{ld_num}
mapper.insert: insert into lodging(ld_name, ld_region, ld_type, ld_number, ld_rating, ld_infor, ld_meal_price, ld_me_num, ld_rg_num) value(#{ld_name}, #{ld_region}, #{ld_type}, #{ld_number}, #{ld_rating}, #{ld_infor}, #{ld_meal_price}, #{ld_me_num}, #{ld_rg_num})
